blocks.text: US President Donald Trump hosts a news conference at the White House on Nov. 20, 2026. —Screenshot from The White House YouTube livestream MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump mistakenly referred to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. as “Prime Minister Marcos” while recounting his trade discussions with the Philippines, as he touted agreements involving billions of dollars in American agricultural products, energy and military equipment. Speaking with reporters at the White House on Friday (Saturday in Philippine time), Trump recalled asking Marcos where the Philippines sourced its energy and whether it should continue buying from the Middle East. “I was with […]...
